description: Type the 404 with `error.code` DATABASE_NOT_FOUND as DatabaseNotFound on the operations that address a database by name and document a 404: the database routes (deleteDatabase, listCollections, deleteCollection, getDatabaseStats, getDatabaseStatus, getMetadataSchema, updateMetadataSchema) and query. The spec types every failure as the shared `handler.ErrorResponse` envelope, whose own example is `error: { code: "DATABASE_NOT_FOUND", message: "Database not found" }`; HydraDB's agent guide (https://docs.hydradb.com/AGENTS.md, section 12) lists DATABASE_NOT_FOUND as 'database missing/not visible' with 404 'database or source not found', and section 8 says a 404 from /query 'means the database name is wrong'. The status alone also covers a missing collection or source, so the class matches on the code. No live response was recorded (no API key yet).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The database does not exist or the API key cannot see it (HydraDB DATABASE_NOT_FOUND, HTTP 404). Check the `database` name; `listDatabases` lists the visible ones.
